title: BYOL-Explore: Exploration by Bootstrapped Prediction
author: Zhaohan Daniel Guo, Shantanu Thakoor, Miruna Pîslar, Bernardo Avila Pires, Florent Altché, Corentin Tallec, Alaa Saade, Daniele Calandriello, Jean-Bastien Grill, Yunhao Tang, Michal Valko, Rémi Munos, Mohammad Gheshlaghi Azar, Bilal Piot
summary: BYOL-Explore is a new method that helps computers explore complex visual environments by learning and predicting in a simple way. It works well in hard tasks where previous methods needed human help. It also beats humans in tough Atari games while being easier to use.
